description: The official MongoDB driver for Rust

docs_notes.cursor_drop_sends_killCursors: src/cursor.rs states that a Cursor still open when dropped is closed by an asynchronous killCursors command.
docs_notes.do_not_drop_driver_future: README section 'Warning about timeouts / cancellation' says dropping a driver future, including via tokio::time::timeout, is not a supported cancel and can leave the driver inconsistent. Futures must be polled to completion.
docs_notes.shutdown_sends_endSessions: Client::shutdown waits for cursor and session cleanup. Client drop schedules endSessions.
docs_notes.retry_writes_default_true: ClientOptions.retry_writes documents the default as true, so this gate sets it to false explicitly.
docs_notes.server_monitoring_mode: Poll uses the polling protocol. Stream can open a separate monitoring socket. This gate sets Poll and records the sockets that actually open.
